Thomas says Republicans can be difficult for pollsters to reach and that some close races could break differently than current polling suggests.

Wall Street for the Physical Buildout
items.snippet: Software is cheap to start. Robots, GPU clusters, and data centers are not. The physical AI buildout will need new ways to finance steel and silicon: lenders, leasing companies, securitization, and hedging products designed around machines and compute. Every great infrastructure boom created financial giants alongside it. Apply for the Winter 2027 batch at ycombinator.com/apply.

items.title: Own Your Intelligence
items.snippet: Most companies building with AI still rent their intelligence from frontier labs. As open models improve, more companies will want models they can run, train, and control themselves. The opportunity is to turn a company’s workflows, expertise, and failures into specialized models that improve with the business. Apply for the Winter 2027 batch at ycombinator.com/apply.
